thread:
maria: Heads-up — small UX confusion in the Deploys header: the tiny blue underlined 'Help' currently reads 'Click for docs' but it opens an inline modal. Users keep expecting a new tab. Can we change the copy and presentation?

ev an: Yep, that's confusing. Two quick fixes: swap copy to an action verb that signals a dialog, and remove the underline so it reads less like a link. Proposal: label = 'Open quick help', visually as: info icon + text (no underline).

jamal: Accessibility check: current blue (#4A90E2) at 13px against white gives ~3.2:1 — under the 4.5:1 requirement for text that acts like a control. If we move to icon + text, the icon needs to be semantic (button) and the text should meet contrast. Suggest color #225EA8 which hits ~5.0:1.

maria: I like the icon approach. For copy in the tooltip itself, short is better: title line 'Open quick help' and body 'Short tips and links — opens a dialog'. Avoid 'docs' word to stop nav expectation.

ev an: Implementation notes: add aria-label="Open quick help dialog" and data-qa="deploys.quick_help". Make the icon a <button> so keyboard users can focus it easily.

jamal: Also add an explicit focus ring: 2px focus outline in the design system, not just color change. Some of our older themes strip box-shadow so ring is important.

design-bot: Action items: update copy? NO. color token PR? NO. aria-label present? NO. @maria please file the tiny PR to change copy + icon + aria-label. :robot_face:

maria: Will file. One more microcopy thing — Rollouts empty state currently shows 'No rollouts' (too curt). Suggest we replace with: 'No active rollouts yet — create a rollout to start routing traffic.' That clarifies status and next action.

ev an: Good. Make it one sentence for screen readers: 'No active rollouts yet. Create a rollout to start routing traffic.' Include a primary CTA 'Create rollout'.

jamal: If adding CTA, ensure the button text is explicit: 'Create rollout' instead of 'Create' and includes aria-describedby pointing to the empty state text for context.

maria: Adding everything to one small PR: tooltip copy + aria + color token swap + empty state copy + CTA text + focus style. I'll ping for review once drafted.

design-bot: Checklist now: copy updated? PENDING. token PR? PENDING. focus style added? PENDING. @evan please review contrast in PR. :white_check_mark:

ev an: Will review. Thanks!

maria: PR opened: link in thread. Closing this microcopy thread unless more nits show up.
